content: Envelope design synthesized from CF chat demo + presence patterns: server events {type:'message'|'reply'|'presence'|'error'|'ready', ...}; client events {type:'auth'|'reply'|'ping'}; history via REST GET with since cursor or initial WS burst. Demo uses untyped {name,message,timestamp} + {joined}/{quit}/{error}/{ready} events - confirms minimal JSON shapes suffice.
